name: fbsir-industry-scene-researcher
description: Find transferable AI-native business cases, examine evidence and mechanisms, and turn research into practical decisions and small pilots.

displayDescription.zh: 从业务难题出发，跨行业找案例、核验证据、拆解智能原生机制，把图文影音转成适合你的行动方案。
displayDescription.en: Find useful cases across industries, check the evidence, and explain how AI changes the work. Turn documents, images and audiovisual material into actions suited to your business.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们做【业务】，想解决【问题】。请找值得借鉴的智能原生案例，包含同业和跨行业思路，比较做法、成效依据与适用条件，建议先试哪一条。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We work in [business] and want to solve [problem]. Find useful AI-native cases from our industry and beyond. Compare how they work, the evidence for their results and the conditions they need, then suggest what to try first.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们做【业务】，想解决【问题】。请找值得借鉴的智能原生案例，包含同业和跨行业思路，比较做法、成效依据与适用条件，建议先试哪一条。
quickPrompts.en: We work in [business] and want to solve [problem]. Find useful AI-native cases from our industry and beyond. Compare how they work, the evidence for their results and the conditions they need, then suggest what to try first.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看这份【资料或案例】：AI改了哪些环节，价值从哪里来，哪些说法还需核实？请核对原始依据、补充同类对照，整理成一页团队简报。
quickPrompts.en: Review these [materials or case]. What does AI change, where could the value come from, and what needs checking? Check the original evidence, add comparable cases and produce a one-page team brief.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们想借鉴【案例或做法】，已有【条件】。哪些能借鉴，哪些要调整？请给小范围试点：步骤、分工、成本、验收指标和停止条件。
quickPrompts.en: We want to learn from [case or approach], with [our current resources and constraints]. What transfers, and what needs adapting? Give us a small pilot with steps, owners, costs, success measures and stopping conditions.
